subject: indicating core, extended and etc in AffymetrixCelSet$fromName

messages.author: 75b52a97a8fa5e5f
messages.subject: indicating core, extended and etc in AffymetrixCelSet$fromName
parts:
I got the following CDF files:
HuEx-1_0-st-v2,control,A20070914,EP.cdf
HuEx-1_0-st-v2,core,A20070914,EP.cdf
HuEx-1_0-st-v2,extended,A20070914,EP.cdf

I put all of them under ..\annotationData\chipTypes\HuEx-1_0-st-v2.
I want to use core CDF, I issued the following command:

> cs <- AffymetrixCelSet$fromName("anth", chipType="HuEx-1_0-st-v2")
> cs <- AffymetrixCelSet$fromName("anth", chipType="HuEx-1_0-st-v2,core,A20070914,EP")

both of them, I got error.
Error in list("AffymetrixCelSet$fromName("anth", chipType = "HuEx-1_0-
st-v2")" = <environment>,

In this case, how should I arrange directories?
